faq.answer1: You search on Krahaso.co by choosing departure, destination and date. We compare offers from our partners and show you the results.
faq.question2: How far in advance should I book my flight?
faq.answer2: Booking 2-3 months in advance is recommended for better prices. However, you can find offers at shorter notice as well.
faq.question3: Is booking done directly on your platform?
faq.answer3: No, our platform helps you compare offers. Final booking is done on the official page of the selected partner.
faq.answer4: Yes, the displayed prices are transparent and include all base fees, with no unexpected additional costs.
faq.question5: Can I book for large groups?
faq.answer5: Yes. You can initially check prices for desired flights, while for discounts or group offers it is recommended to contact the partner directly.
faq.answer6: If you need more information, you can contact us via the contact numbers or email found on the Contact page.

faq.question1: How does car rental search work?
faq.answer1: You search by choosing location, dates and car category. We compare offers and show you the results.
faq.answer2: Personal details and upload of ID or passport and valid driving licence are required.
faq.answer3: Yes. We aim to show transparent prices with main details included, so you avoid surprises at the end.
faq.question4: Can I return the car at a different location?
faq.answer4: Yes, if the rental company allows it, you can choose another return location from the available options.
faq.question5: How far in advance should I book?
faq.answer5: We recommend booking 1–2 weeks ahead for better prices and availability. You can still find offers at shorter notice.
faq.answer6: If you need more information, you can contact us via the contact numbers or email found on the Contact page.
